description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain class implementations including reentrant, non-reentrant, stream handling, self-managed grains, and a class for testing call ordering and interleaving behavior.

classes.name: ReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain with simple methods for testing reentrant behavior.

classes.name: NonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant grain utilizing logging for method entry and exit, demonstrating non-reentrant execution.

classes.name: MayInterleaveStaticPredicateGrain
classes.description: A grain with a static method that determines whether calls may interleave based on message argument.

classes.name: MayInterleaveInstancedPredicateGrain
classes.description: Similar to static predicate grain, but with instance-based predicate for interleaving logic.

classes.name: UnorderedNonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A grain demonstrating unordered, non-reentrant method calls.

classes.name: ReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: A self-managed, reentrant grain capable of ping-pong communication via grain factory.

classes.name: NonReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: A self-managed, non-reentrant grain with similar functionality to the reentrant version.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: A grain performing fan-out pattern calls to other grains with both reentrant and non-reentrant variants.

classes.name: FanOutACGrain
classes.description: A fan-out grain with AC (auto-chaining) reentrant and non-reentrant method variants.

classes.name: ReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain implementing delay and counter logic, capable of pinging other grains.

classes.name: NonReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant counterpart to ReentrantTaskGrain, with similar ping and counter functionality.

classes.name: CallOrderingGrain
classes.description: A grain used to test method call ordering and interleaving, featuring an internal log and synchronization control.

methods.name: Two
methods.description: Concatenates the result of Self.One() with " two".

methods.name: SetSelf
methods.description: Assigns the Self grain reference to enable self-referential calls.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle hook triggered upon grain activation, often used for initialization.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a delay, then pings another grain and logs the value.

methods.name: MethodA
methods.description: Marks the start of method A; used in interleave testing.

methods.name: MethodB
methods.description: Marks the start of method B; used in interleave testing.

methods.name: Unblock
methods.description: Unblocks paused methods A and B to test call ordering.
